mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id AS tenantId,a.project_id AS projectId,m.document_id AS documentId,a.annotation_id AS annotationId,a.document_revision AS originalDocumentRevision FROM annotation a JOIN document_revision_meta m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.project_id=a.project_id AND m.document_revision=a.document_revision WHERE a.annotation_id=#{annotationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.tenant_id AS tenantId,a.project_id AS projectId,m.document_id AS documentId,a.annotation_id AS annotationId,a.document_revision AS originalDocumentRevision FROM annotation a JOIN document_revision_meta m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.project_id=a.project_id AND m.document_revision=a.document_revision WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY a.created_at,a.annotation_id LIMIT #{fetchLimit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotation a JOIN document_revision_meta m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.project_id=a.project_id AND m.document_revision=a.document_revision WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.document_id=#{documentId}
SELECT anchor_id AS anchorId,revision FROM annotation_effective_anchor e WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,anchor_id,annotation_id,document_revision,node_id,selection,selection_artifact_id,selection_sha256,selection_object_version,previous_anchor_id,annotation_revision,reason,actor_id,created_by,created_at,classification,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM annotation_anchor k WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId} AND anchor_id=#{anchorId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,anchor_id,annotation_id,document_revision,node_id,selection,selection_artifact_id,selection_sha256,selection_object_version,previous_anchor_id,annotation_revision,reason,actor_id,created_by,created_at,classification,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM annotation_anchor k WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId} ORDER BY annotation_revision LIMIT #{fetchLimit} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotation_anchor k WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE annotation_effective_anchor SET anchor_id=#{anchorId},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId} AND anchor_id=#{previousAnchorId} AND revision=#{expectedAnchorRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('transition_id',transition_id,'kind',kind,'previous_revision',CAST(previous_revision AS CHAR),'revision',CAST(revision AS CHAR),'previous_status',previous_status,'status',status,'previous_anchor_id',previous_anchor_id,'anchor_id',anchor_id,'document_revision',document_revision,'actor_id',actor_id,'reason',reason,'created_at',DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')) FROM annotation_transition t WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId} AND transition_id=#{transitionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('document_id',m.document_id,'transition_id',transition_id,'kind',kind,'previous_revision',CAST(previous_revision AS CHAR),'revision',CAST(revision AS CHAR),'previous_status',previous_status,'status',status,'previous_anchor_id',previous_anchor_id,'anchor_id',anchor_id,'document_revision',t.document_revision,'actor_id',actor_id,'reason',reason,'created_at',DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')) FROM annotation_transition t JOIN document_revision_meta m ON m.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND m.project_id=t.project_id AND m.document_revision=t.document_revision WHERE t.project_id=#{projectId} AND annotation_id=#{annotationId} ORDER BY t.revision LIMIT 10001 FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,operation_id,subject_id,operation_name,idempotency_key,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref, target_id,error_code,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at, dedup_expires_at,dedup_policy_revision FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='RV-06-REANCHOR-1' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE aggregate_id=#{annotationId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resulting} AND event_type='annotation.reanchored'

SELECT invalidation_id AS invalidationId,review_id AS reviewId,trigger_version AS triggerVersion,reason_code AS reasonCode FROM review_invalidation i WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND trigger_version=#{artifactId} AND reason_code='ANNOTATION_REANCHORED' ORDER BY review_id FOR UPDATE
